runCheckNowNote: The check was started. Results arrive as notifications.
setPrereleasesDesc: Count beta and RC versions for newly added apps.
setMinAgeDesc: Offer a new release only after this long, in case it turns out to be a bad one.
setPinningDesc: Trust only the known certificates of GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg and RuStore.
setDataDesc: The file format is the same as {}'s, so lists move both ways.
addLinkHint: Link to the app's page: GitHub, GitLab, F-Droid, a store, or a direct link to an APK
catHint: Tap the colour to change it, the name to rename.
importLinksNote: Package names become known after the first install; until then such apps may show as not installed.
setPretendPlayDesc: With Shizuku or root, record Google Play as the installer. Some apps refuse to work otherwise. Can also be set per app.
opt.trackOnly: Only report new versions; nothing is downloaded or installed.
opt.versionDetection: Take the installed version from the device rather than from what was installed here.
opt.releaseDateAsVersion: Use the release date as the version, for sources without proper version numbers.
opt.useVersionCodeAsOSVersion: Compare the installed version by version code rather than by name.
opt.versionExtractionRegEx: A regular expression that cuts the version number out of the release name.
opt.matchGroupToUse: Which group of that expression to take as the version.
opt.apkFilterRegEx: A regular expression: only files with a matching name are taken.
opt.invertAPKFilter: Take the files that do NOT match the filter.
opt.autoApkFilterByArch: Leave out files built for another processor architecture.
opt.includeZips: Look for APKs inside the ZIP archives of a release.
opt.zippedApkFilterRegEx: A filter for APK names inside the archive.
opt.includeTarballs: Look for APKs inside tar archives.
opt.tarballedApkFilterRegEx: A filter for APK names inside the archive.
opt.skipUpdateNotifications: Send no notifications about new versions.
opt.refreshBeforeDownload: Ask for the links again right before downloading, in case they expire quickly.
opt.shizukuPretendToBeGooglePlay: With Shizuku or root, record Google Play as the installer.
opt.appName: Show in the list under this name.
opt.about: A note to yourself; shown in the details of the app.
opt.includePrereleases: Count beta, RC and other pre-releases.
opt.fallbackToOlderReleases: When the latest release has no suitable file, take the one before it.
opt.verifyLatestTag: Check against the release the source itself marks as latest.
opt.useLatestAssetDateAsReleaseDate: Use the date of the newest uploaded file as the release date.
opt.releaseTitleAsVersion: Use the release title as the version instead of the tag.
opt.filterReleaseTitlesByRegEx: Only releases with a matching title are taken.
opt.filterReleaseNotesByRegEx: Only releases with matching notes are taken.
opt.checkRepoRename: Notice when the repository has moved to a new address.
opt.trySelectingSuggestedVersionCode: Take the version F-Droid itself suggests.
opt.autoSelectHighestVersionCode: Take the version with the highest version code.
opt.filterVersionsByRegEx: Only versions with a matching name are taken.
opt.sortMethodChoice: The order releases are compared in to find the latest.
opt.minimumUpdateAgeDays: Offer a release only after this long.
opt.appId: The package name, to tie the entry to an app that is already installed.
opt.overrideSource: For a self-hosted instance of a known service: say how to talk to it.
opt.github-creds: Without it GitHub allows about 60 requests an hour. Also opens your private repositories.
opt.GHReqPrefix: A mirror to download through where GitHub is slow or blocked. Normally empty.
opt.gitlab-creds: Needed for search on GitLab and for private projects.
opt.sortColumn: What the list of apps is ordered by.
opt.sortOrder: From A to Z or the other way round.
opt.groupBy: Split the list into groups with headings.
optTitle.useLatestAssetDateAsReleaseDate: Release date from the newest file
opt.allowedSigningCertHashes: Install only files signed with one of these certificates (SHA-256).
catExists: There is already a category with this name
detSignerConflict: Another build of this app is installed - it is signed with a different key, so this one cannot be installed over it. Remove the installed app first.
telegramFilePattern: Which file of the channel to follow (app | build)
telegramSignInFirst: Sign in to Telegram in the Sources settings first: the files of a channel can only be read by an account.
telegramNoAnswer: Telegram did not answer in time.
telegramDesc: An account is needed to track apps posted in Telegram channels. The session is kept on this device only.
telegramNotConfigured: This build was made without Telegram API keys, so Telegram channels are not available.
telegramPhone: Phone number, with the country code
telegramUnsupported: Telegram asks for a step this app cannot do ({}). Finish it in the Telegram app and try again.
telegramSignOutConfirm: Apps tracked from Telegram channels will stop being checked until you sign in again.
telegramQrHint: Scan this code with Telegram on another device where you are signed in: Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device. It cannot be confirmed from this phone.
telegramByPhone: Sign in with a phone number
telegramCodeApp: The code was sent to Telegram on your other devices.
telegramCodeSms: The code was sent by SMS or a call.
telegramErrPhone: This phone number is not valid. Enter it with the country code, like +79001234567.
telegramErrBanned: Telegram has blocked this phone number.
telegramErrNoAccount: There is no Telegram account with this number.
telegramErrCodeExpired: The code has expired. Start over to get a new one.
telegramErrEmail: This e-mail address is not valid.
telegramErrNoChannel: There is no public channel with this name.
telegramErrPrivate: This channel is private, or the account has no access to it.
telegramErrKeys: Telegram does not accept this app. Update APK Toolbox.
telegramErrFileGone: The file is no longer in the channel.
telegramErrSession: The Telegram session has ended: it was closed from another device, or the account is no longer available. Sign in again in the Sources settings.
telegramViaQr: Sign in with a QR code
telegramChannelsNote: channels that post apps as files
telegramErrArch: This file is built for {}, and this device runs {}. Choose another file.
telegramNoAnswerState: Telegram does not answer, so the sign-in could not be checked.
srcCheckFailed:
The last check of this app failed:
{}
cloneInstallTaken: {} is taken by an app that is not a clone of this one
cloneTracked: The clone is now updated from the Sources tab
cloneNoSource: Not found in any of the stores. Add the app in Sources from wherever it is published: its clone is picked up there.
cloneReinstallMessage: The app is installed as it is. A clone is a separate app that starts empty: the data, the sign-ins and the settings of the installed app do not move over. The installed app stays until you remove it. A clone is signed with APK Toolbox's key, so sign-in with Google, payments and checks of the kind may not work in it.
cloneBackToAppMessage: The clone will be removed with everything in it, and the app will be installed anew as its publisher made it, with every permission. The clone's data, sign-ins and settings are lost and cannot be brought back.
cloneBackToAppKeptMessage: The clone will be removed with everything in it. The app itself is installed already and stays as it is. The clone's data, sign-ins and settings are lost and cannot be brought back.
